title: Sunset Lake Camp

services.name: Tent Site
services.desc: Sunset Lake is unlike any place you’ve experienced but when you arrive you’ll feel at home. There is a sense of wonder that you feel as you stand beneath a towering cedar tree or sit by the lake and soak up the afternoon sun. We offer comfortable housing, flexible meeting spaces, and amazing opportunities for rest and adventures for our retreat season guests. For those of you interested in our summer camp, this is just a glimpse of what summer camp looks like. Connect with us for more info. Our gymnasium can seat up to 500 people and boasts a full basketball court, two volleyball courts, and two additional breakout rooms. blurb: Join us for a summer of exciting outdoor adventures at Sunset Lake Summer Camp! Our camps are designed to be imagined as an expedition up a mountain. With each summer, new and unexpected adventures await, while each step of the journey shapes our campers to be the leaders in life that God calls them to be.
